description: 后翼弃兵接受D27 — 关键时机：dxc4→c5→b5→e5四步时机链

intro.popup_en:
Key Timing, Practice 10: Queen's Gambit Accepted
Accepting the gambit is easy; choosing when to counterattack is harder. Follow the four-step timing sequence: ...dxc4, ...c5, ...b5, and ...e5.
intro.popup:
关键时机练习10

后翼弃兵接受！

接受兵容易，何时出击才难

练习目标：
掌握dxc4→c5→b5→e5四步时机链

outro.popup_en: The four timing points: accept immediately with ...dxc4; play ...c5 while White's bishop is on c4 to challenge d4; use ...b5 to drive the bishop away when White's queen is on e2; and answer e4 at once with ...e5. The sequence depends on the position at each step.
outro.popup:
QGA时机总结

四步时机链：
① dxc4！：白方推c4立刻接受
② c5！：象在c4时挑战d4
③ b5！：后在e2时驱逐象
④ e5！：白方e4时立即反击

时机是连续的！

moves.popup_en: d4 opens with the Queen's Pawn Opening.
c4 offers the Queen's Gambit pawn.

moves.popup:
dxc4！时机！
立刻接受，保持领先
moves.popup_en: ...dxc4! Black accepts immediately and keeps the extra pawn while White spends time recovering it.
e3 prepares to recover the pawn with Bxc4.
Bxc4 recovers the gambit pawn with the bishop.

moves.popup:
c5！时机！
象在c4时立刻反击d4
moves.popup_en: ...c5! The bishop is on c4, so Black immediately challenges d4 at the right moment.
Nc3 develops and supports the center.

moves.popup:
b5！时机！
后在e2，象在c4
用b5驱象赢节奏
moves.popup_en: ...b5! With White's queen on e2 and bishop on c4, Black drives the bishop away and gains a tempo.
Bd3 retreats the bishop to a defensive square.
a3 prepares b4 to challenge the bishop.
Bb2 places White's bishop on its long diagonal.

moves.popup:
e5！时机！
白方e4时立即反击！
不等待就是时机
moves.popup_en: ...e5! Black counterattacks immediately as White advances e4. Waiting would miss the moment; timing is the key.
